name: meteors
title: Meteors
description: Now and then a thin streak of light crosses a night sky at one shared angle and burns out; long quiet gaps between them. CSS only: each streak is a gradient line moved with transform.

meta.reducedMotion: A designed still: a long-exposure night, star trails wheeling round the pole and one bright meteor crossing them at the same angle, over a low horizon. The streak tracks are not rendered.
meta.useWhen: Night skies, observatories, wishes, launches that are literal (a rocket club), New Year: behind one dark hero.
meta.avoidWhen: As "speed" or "innovation" decoration; light themes; more than one sky per page; busy sections where a flicker at the edge distracts from reading.
